intro: This first New York page covers private mailbox stores in Manhattan and Brooklyn whose own public pages list an address, staffed hours, and the carriers they accept. It is not a complete citywide inventory. 24-hour lobby access is flagged only when the store’s page says so. The UPS Store pages mention 24-hour access only at participating locations, so that flag is off for those stores unless a store-specific page confirms it. Box availability can change; treat it as something to confirm, not as live inventory. If you cannot get to a storefront, compare virtual mailbox services.

listings.name: Mailbox NYC

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the week of November 18, 2026, as shown on the mailbox rental page. The same page says mailbox customers have 24-hour access to a lit, secured lobby.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental page says the store accepts packages and mail from the Post Office, UPS, FedEx, DHL, and couriers, and offers mail forwarding.
listings.visitNotes: Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.

listings.name: Postman Joe

hours.notes: The mailbox rental page says you can pick up during store hours: Monday–Friday 9:00am–7:00pm, Saturday–Sunday 10:00am–6:00pm, and that the store is open every day of the week. We did not find a 24-hour lobby claim on that page.

listings.carriersNotes: The FAQ on the mailbox rental page says the store accepts deliveries from all major carriers — UPS, FedEx, DHL, USPS — as well as most courier services, and that the street address is accepted by all carriers.
listings.visitNotes: Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.

listings.name: Copy Experts NYC

hours.notes: Hours as published on the mailbox rental page. Sunday is listed as “Closed*” without an explanation of the asterisk on the page we checked. A second phone number, (212) 875-0948, also appears on that page.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox rental FAQ says the store can accept packages from all major carriers, including USPS, UPS, FedEx, and DHL.
listings.visitNotes: Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
listings.feeNotes: The mailbox rental page lists monthly prices from $60.00 for a small personal box to $128.00 for a large business box, with a three-month minimum purchase. Confirm the current rate when you sign up.

listings.name: Manhattan Mailboxes

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the homepage. The “Other Services” page says fax receiving for mailbox customers is 24/7; it does not say the mailbox lobby is open 24 hours.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox services page says the store can accept any kind of delivery, including US Mail, FedEx, UPS, and messenger deliveries, and “if it fits through the door we’ll take it.” Amazon and DHL are not named on that page.
listings.visitNotes: Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
listings.feeNotes: The site has a separate mailbox rates page; we did not copy prices here because this listing is sourced from the services and hours pages we checked.

listings.name: The UPS Store — 82 Nassau St

hours.notes: Staffed store hours from the official location page’s opening-hours data. This store’s mailbox-services page also has store-specific copy that says “A mailbox that works for you with 24 Hour Access” and “24-HOUR MAILBOX ACCESS.” Confirm after-hours lobby access when you rent.

listings.carriersNotes: The mailbox-services page says mailbox customers can receive mail and parcels from any carrier including USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL and others.
listings.visitNotes: The mailbox-services page names USPS, FedEx, UPS, DHL and others, and lists the mailing address as 82 Nassau Street with a box or suite number provided at signup. The same mailbox-services template also lists “24-hour access (at participating locations),” which does not confirm after-hours lobby access at this store unless the store’s own page says so. Box availability is not published as live inventory. Confirm with the store that a box is actually open.
